opening.argument: The presentation promotes delegating digital assets to the Intelligent Dog automated arbitrage system while offering approximately 6% to 18% of monthly profit to the user's wallet. It further presents a multi-level commission structure: direct sharing is tied to “100% of intellectual benefits,” while participants in the second through tenth layers generate an additional 10% share of smart gains. The combination of delegated trading, stated monthly returns, and commissions linked to expanding referral layers establishes the promoted opportunity as a trading-bot or funded-contract returns scheme. The material does not establish that any transfer occurred, that returns were achieved, or that these claims were independently verified; nor does the available evidence establish that entrusted assets were unaffected by price fluctuations.
